thread:
tanya: Kicking off v2.16 canary. Plan: gradual enable of `rec-experimental` via slowstart (2% initial, +2% every 6m) until 20%. Change window 04:00-05:00 UTC. Pin model to rwd-model-2026-03-22 for the canary.

 deploy-bot: Deploy v2.16 started on prod-us-east. Canary target group = cohort-rec-canary.

 mike: Pinning model: `/infra pin-model --service rec-api --version rwd-model-2026-03-22` — leaving pin until >=20% stable.

 tanya: Enabling slowstart now: `/ff set rec-experimental --mode slowstart --target 2 --step 2 --interval 360 --reason "v2.16 canary"`

 deploy-bot: Slowstart active: targets 2 -> 4 -> 6 (progressing). Auto-circuit: disable if error_delta > 1.0% or p95 +120ms or embedding-queue > 100.

 release-cre: Added release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/v2.16 and runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/ff-rollouts.

 sre-bot: Reminder: if we hit auto-disable, oncall should follow rollback play: 1) `/ff set rec-experimental --target 0 --force` 2) `/infra rollback-release --id v2.16` 3) verify KV cache flush for the old model.

 ops-oncall: I'm watching dashboards (ff-canary-rec) and will mute low-priority alerts. Key metrics: error-rate, p95/p99, model mem, queue depth, cache hit%.

 deploy-bot: Slowstart reached 10% -> telemetry OK: error-rate +0.2%, p95 +18ms, mem 58%. Proceeding.

 mike: QA found inconsistent ranking in one internal cohort (internal-A) but not in public. Not blocking for now. Logging a bug: INC-4121.

 tanya: We'll wait 45m at 20% observation before any 100% flip. If anything crosses thresholds, immediate abort and rollback. Snippet for quick abort:
`curl -XPOST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN\" \"https://api.redwood/flags/rec-experimental?action=set&target=0\"`

 deploy-bot: Reached 20% -> smoke run for 10m. No SLO breaches.

 sre-bot: All green. Recommend 90m soak then 100% enable during next night window. If we need to force-disable during high load, use `--force` flag with the ff set command.

 tanya: Thanks. I'll post a follow-up before the 100% rollout and update the change window if we proceed.
